gaps.sentence: The ___ (POPULAR) of the band grew after the film.

gaps.explanation: After 'Her' a noun is needed: illness (-ness noun of 'ill').

gaps.sentence: He is very ___ about local history (KNOW).
gaps.explanation: 'Knowledgeable about something' means knowing a lot about it; it is the adjective form of 'knowledge'.
After 'complete' a noun is needed: darkness (-ness noun of 'dark').

gaps.sentence: Their ___ goes back to their schooldays (FRIEND).
gaps.hint: noun needed: the state of being friends (-ship)
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ship forms nouns of state: friendship means the relationship between friends.
The suffix -en forms verbs from adjectives: thicken. A base verb follows 'to'.

gaps.sentence: The old factory will be ___ into flats (MODERN).
gaps.hint: verb needed in the passive (-ise); past participle
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ise forms the verb: modernise. The passive 'will be' needs the past participle 'modernised'.

gaps.sentence: He had a happy ___ in the countryside (CHILD).
gaps.hint: noun needed: the period of being a child (-hood)
gaps.explanation: The suffix -hood forms period-of-life nouns: childhood.
